title: Judge Blocks F.C.C. From Targeting Disney’s Local ABC Licenses

title: Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade Sours Holiday Plans for Tourists
summary: With a powerful storm bearing down on New York, the parade was postponed to Saturday, by which time many of the city’s visitors planned to be elsewhere.

title: The Thanksgiving Parade on Saturday. Can They Do That?
